meta.title: fix: improve deploy history performance and code quality
meta.body_summary: Improve deploy history screen performance via database indexes, trigger optimization, server‑side search with debounce, and selective field fetching.

core_change_summary.description: Added composite database indexes for deploy history queries, optimised `record_deployment_history` trigger, implemented server‑side search with debounce in `HistoryTable.vue`, selected only necessary fields for data fetching, and improved error handling in `update_metadata` endpoint.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Majority of changed lines are in localisation files, type updates, and merge artifacts; core performance changes are limited to SQL indexes and frontend refactor.
